item.title: Farmers Demand Bord Bia Chair’s Resignation at Protest Today
item.description: A farmers' protest today will call for the Bord Bia chair to step down. The IFA has decided to continue the demonstration outside Bord Bia's offices in Dublin until Larry Murrin resigns or is removed. It took the decision after a meeting yesterday over his importation of some Brazilian beef last year in his role as CEO of Dawn Farm Foods. item.title: Over 4,000 Employed by IDA Client Companies in Shannonside Region Last Year
item.description: There were over 4,000 people employed in IDA client companies in the Shannonside region last year. The figures were released by Enterprise Minister Peter Burke following a Parliamentary Question by Fianna Fáil TD Cathal Crowe. Roscommon has the most IDA supported jobs locally with 1,625. Advertisement Longford was close behind with just over 1,500 jobs whilst almost 1,200 people in Leitrim were employed in IDA client companies last year.

item.title: Cunningham calls time on St. Brigids spell
item.description: St. Brigid’s GAA club have confirmed the departure of Anthony Cunningham as manager. item.title: Local MEP Calls on European Commission to Investigate X
item.description: A local MEP has called on the European Commission to launch an investigation into social media platform X. It's AI tool Grook has generated deepfakes, targeting women and children. Despite growing concern, the European Commission, which is responsible for enforcing the EU's Digital Services Act on platforms such as X, has yet to launch a formal investigation. Advertisement Midlands North West MEP Nina Carberry says tools must be rolled out with robust safeguards.

item.title: Longford score second hurling win
item.description: Longford registering their second win of Allianz hurling league division four with a 1-14 to 1-12 win over Cavan. Cathal Mullane came off the bench to net a crucial goal for Longford in his 100th appearance for his county. The game was moved to Michael Fay Park home of Longford slashers. Cavan led 1-8 to six points at half-time. Cavan were reduced to 14 men when Dylan McKeever was sent-off on 46 minutes. Advertisement Elsewhere, Sligo scored a 2-20 to 18 point win over Leitrim in Carrick-on-Shan
